    A World Class Venue
    in the Heart of the City

    The Mattioli Arena is Leicester's largest indoor venue
    Host to events drawing global audiences in person, on terrestrial TV and online.
    Home to the Leicester Riders professional basketball team, the arena is equally a home for your high-profile corporate or private event.
    ​​
    Conferences of all sizes
    Trade Shows
    Exhibitions
    Concerts and Performances
    Tournaments and Competitions
    ​​​
    The Mattioli Arena is a uniquely flexible venue with a wide range of rooms, halls, facilities and services capable of hosting any size event. We provide a truly bespoke service with individual event design, in-house catering and event management.

    🏀 WHO’S IN YOUR STARTING 5?

    Who’s in your Starting 5? 🏀 This Friday, Leicester Riders take on Liverpool Basketball at Mattioli Arena — and we want you to build your Riders Starting 5. Already got your 5? Bring the bench! Get a group of 5 or more together for Friday’s game and you could WIN £150! Already booked? Your existing tickets count. Simply encourage your friends, family, neighbours or community group to join you and book their tickets. Separate orders can be combined to make up your Starting 5.

    Important Spectator Information for Friday’s Pre-Season Game

    Live basketball returns to Mattioli Arena on Friday 11 September, as Leicester Riders face Super League Basketball newcomers Liverpool Basketball in a pre-season friendly. Doors open at 5:30pm, with tip-off at 7:30pm. There will be no separate Fanzone for this game; however, food, drinks, seating and activities will be available inside the main arena before tip-off.
